title: Septic shock
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Recognise deterioration and escalate with SBAR.
Monitor vasopressor administration within orders and protocol.

expected_actions.text: Recognise physiological deterioration with the unit's early warning score and escalate it early.
Use a structured SBAR handover to escalate to the responsible team.
When a vasopressor is prescribed, check the infusion site for extravasation and avoid abrupt interruption.

gaps: No published clinical scenario may exist until the review phase: this is a specification only.
The branching content, consequences and scoring are the author's reading of the cited sources and have had no clinical review.
The sepsis pathway steps, fluid decisions and thresholds are not written; they rest on the 2026 guideline text, which was not read in full.
